items.example: I'm looking for my keys.
items.simple: You want to find something. You are looking where it is.

items.example: I need to find out what time it starts.
items.simple: You did not know something. Now you know.

items.example: Can you pick me up at six?
items.simple: You hold something and lift it up.

items.example: Don't give up. You're almost there!
items.simple: You stop trying. It is too hard.

items.example: Can you turn up the volume a bit?
items.simple: You make the sound louder. Or a person comes, and you did not know they would.
items.note: 'He didn't turn up' = gelmedi, ortada yoktu.

items.example: Please turn down the music.
items.simple: You make the sound quieter. Or you say no to something.
items.note: Teklifi reddetmek için de: turn down an offer.

items.example: Please put your toys away.
items.simple: You put a thing back where it lives.

items.example: We've run out of milk.
items.simple: There is none left. It is all gone.
items.note: 'We ran out of time' = zamanımız kalmadı.

items.example: Can you look after my dog this weekend?
items.exampleTr: Bu hafta sonu köpeğime bakabilir misin?
items.simple: You keep someone or something safe and happy.

items.example: Please fill in this form.
items.simple: You write the words in the empty boxes on paper.

items.example: Do you want to go out tonight?
items.exampleTr: Bu akşam dışarı çıkmak ister misin?
items.simple: You leave the house and go outside.

items.example: I get along well with my neighbours.
items.simple: You like each other and are nice together.

items.example: Don't throw that away. I still need it.
items.simple: You do not want it. You put it in the bin.

items.example: Please sit down. I'll be right back.
items.simple: You bend your legs and put your bottom on a chair.

items.example: He didn't show up for the meeting.
items.simple: You come to a place. People see you there.

items.example: Sorry to interrupt. Please carry on.
items.simple: You do not stop. You keep doing it.

items.example: Hang on a second. I'll be right there.
items.simple: You ask someone to wait for a little time.

items.example: Why don't you come over after work?
items.simple: You come to someone's house for a visit.

items.example: Hurry up! We're going to be late.
items.simple: You move fast because you do not have much time.

items.example: Calm down. It's not a big problem.
items.exampleTr: Sakin ol. Büyük bir sorun değil.
items.simple: You were angry or scared. Now you are quiet and okay again.

items.example: I grew up in a small town.
items.simple: You get bigger and older. A child becomes a grown-up.

items.example: Cheer up! Tomorrow will be better.
items.simple: You were sad. Now you feel happy again.

items.example: I'm looking forward to the holiday.
items.simple: You are happy because something good will come.
items.note: Ardından isim veya -ing gelir: looking forward to seeing you.

items.example: Can you drop me off at the station?
items.simple: You take someone to a place and leave them there.
